feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 28 May 2026 4:47am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at times.


##Wind)##

E or SE 4 or 5, occasionally 6 at first this morning, decreasing 3 or 4 this afternoon, veering S or SW 4 to 6 late afternoon or early evening. Decreasing 4 or 5 tonight.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate becoming mainly moderate this evening.


##Weather)##

Showers at first soon clearing to become mainly fair this morning, then the risk of some coastal mist/fog patches developing from the south later this afternoon.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers at first, then falling poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

SW 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 during the afternoon, then backing S or SW later.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate falling slight.


##Weather)##

Fair.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Saturday, 30 May 2026##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

S or SW 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5, then 5 or 6 for the evening for a time, veering W or SW 4 or 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Fair, then rain for a time.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Sunday, 31 May 2026##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

SW 4 or 5, backing S 3 or 4 later, decreasing 2 or 3 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather)##

Isolated showers, then rain late.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain late.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C

Nil.

S 2 or 3, veering SW 4 or 5.

##Weather)##

##Visibility)##
